checks: The three inverse-image vertices are (4,−2),(−4/5,8/5),(−4/5,−4/5). Exact shoelace area gives V=144/25 and the centered image has area E=9/2. The positive forward denominator pulls the energy gradient back to the zero first moment of D. The parameter Hessian is positive definite since the triangle has interior.

The three cone sectors of D have equal area, so each edge has cone density dt/3. The H₀ intervals on the first two edges are [1/3,1]; the H₁ intervals are [0,2/3] on AB and a length-2/3 piece on BC. The affine reflection fixes ξ₁ and exchanges H₁,H₂.

Integrating L and L^(−2) exactly yields energy values 1/3,1/2,1/2 and ordinary values 25/36,8/27,8/27, with E/V=25/32. Combining them with weights 2/3,1/3 gives 49/108,35/81,35/81. The latter is below 4/9.
The through-mark ordinary cone fraction is exactly the original cap-volume fraction. The original raw budgets are therefore unequal, as required by the source's restricted scope.
